decisions.reason: Moving and reorienting the sensor-board connectors does not change their types, references, pinouts, roles, or the interboard power and signal architecture.
The source changes the sensor-board connector layout and does not change the main-board dimensions or establish a new main-board fit or routing constraint.
Connector relocation on the sensor board does not change the separate-board architecture, board count, or board identities.
The source concerns bottom connectors on the sensor board, not battery or interboard connector accessibility on the power board.
The sensor-board connector placement decision does not change the main board's four-layer stack.
The source does not alter ESP32 antenna placement or clearance.
The source changes sensor-board connector placement and does not affect power-board orientation, dimensions, mounting, or enclosure fit.
The sensor-board connector relocation does not change the power board's four-layer stack.
The source changes physical placement and access orientation, while the fanout requirement's connector count, module assignments, connector types, and signals remain unchanged.
Repositioning sensor-board connectors does not change the monitored rails, monitor device, channel count, or measurement coverage.
The sensor-board connector layout decision does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
The connector placement change does not affect DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
